The week, in one breath

Fireworks, fumes and one brutal injury

Jahmyr Gibbs detonated for 37.9, Bijan Robinson answered with 34.3, and Jaxon Smith-Njigba supplied 30.4 that went completely to waste. J9hunna escaped the week’s closest game by 5.6 despite posting just 97.9; Honk Dawgs administered the 49.4-point blowout; @J9 made a roster move. and Honk Dawgs remain 3–0, while lexxyfour stands alone at 0–3.

Game Stories

Every matchup gets a case file, a culprit and one completely imagined quote.
Thriller

J9 wins ugly enough to need a permit

@J9 made a roster move. def. lotes | 97.9 – 92.3

J9 · 3–0BY 5.6lotes · 1–2

Jared Goff (19.4), Christian Watson (19.1), Matthew Golden (18.5) and Davante Adams (17.2) dragged J9 across the line while Chase Brown and Breece Hall combined for 14.9. The tight-end room was less a room than an abandoned hallway: Jake Ferguson and Hunter Henry combined for 2.4.

lotes got the week’s third-best starter score from Smith-Njigba, then nobody else cracked 15. J9 scored fewer than five losing teams and still walked out 3–0. Undefeated is undefeated; aesthetically, this was a misdemeanor.

“The standings do not include a style column.”Imagined postgame quote · J9hunna
Blowout

Honk Dawgs win; Steven’s floor disappears

Honk Dawgs def. Steven diggs | 118.4 – 69.0

Honk · 3–0BY 49.4Steven · 1–2

Michael Wilson scored 20.4, James Cook 19.4, Patrick Mahomes 16.9, Chris Olave 15.2 and Travis Kelce 12.9. Honk Dawgs did not need a miracle; it needed the opponent to keep submitting numbers.

Lamar Jackson (20.4) and CeeDee Lamb (16.7) tried. Then Achane left with 1.7, Kyle Pitts posted 1.0 and New England’s defense scored −1.0. The injury is no joke; the fantasy scoreboard afterward was cruelly definitive.

“We brought 118. They brought a negative defense.”Imagined postgame quote · TysonsHill
Comedy

Mommas Home itemizes a 157-point bill

Mommas Home <3 def. The CMC Machine | 157.4 – 120.1

Mommas · 2–1BY 37.3CMC · 2–1

Garrett Wilson led with only 21.7, which tells the whole story. Trevor Lawrence, Harold Fannin, Jaylen Warren, Javonte Williams, Terry McLaurin, Deebo Samuel and Chuba Hubbard joined him in double digits. Eight useful performances, no cape required.

The CMC Machine was respectable almost everywhere—Christian McCaffrey 19.6, Dak Prescott 18.9, Minnesota D/ST 17.0—but explosive nowhere. Malik Nabers (5.1) and Jacory Croskey-Merritt (4.8) turned a competitive lineup into a 37-point receipt.

“We didn’t boom them. We itemized them.”Imagined postgame quote · pfsumol
Drama

Bijan scores 34; the loss is 33

Everybody Hurts def. Pirates of the CaribBijan | 138.7 – 105.7

Hurts · 1–2BY 33.0Pirates · 1–2

Drake London scored 23.9, George Kittle 23.2, Jeremiyah Love 19.4 and Juwan Johnson 19.3. Everybody Hurts’ tight ends combined for 42.5, and Sebp finally put a win beside the team name.

The Pirates got 34.3 from Bijan and 12.9 from Zay Flowers. Jalen Coker, T.J. Hockenson and Kaleb Johnson then combined for only 7.0. The cruelest math of Week 3: your star nearly matches the loss margin by himself.

“Turns out Everybody Hurts less after scoring 138.7.”Imagined postgame quote · Sebp
Game Recap

Shough shines; the cast misses rehearsal

Kings of New York def. I WILL FUCK MADISON BEER | 111.2 – 82.4

KKings · 2–1BY 28.8Madison · 1–2

Matthew Stafford (22.9) and Derrick Henry (21.4) set the pace for New York, with Bhayshul Tuten (16.0) and Houston’s defense (13.0) supplying the paperwork. Tetairoa McMillan’s 2.7 dud never became dangerous.

Shough outscored Lamar Jackson. It did not matter. Saquon Barkley and Justin Jefferson combined for 12.7; Dalton Kincaid, Khalil Shakir and Jadarian Price combined for 4.6. One actor knew the lines. The rest missed rehearsal.

“The crown is light when Derrick Henry carries it.”Imagined postgame quote · LApunkTC
Comedy

Gibbs outscores an entire receiver room

Romo’s Rum Runner def. lexxyfour | 125.5 – 101.8

Romo · 1–2BY 23.7lexxy · 0–3

Gibbs supplied the league’s top individual score, with Josh Allen (19.0), Tee Higgins (18.0) and Wan’Dale Robinson (15.2) doing enough around him. J.K. Dobbins, Tucker Kraft and Chris Godwin all stayed under six; this was still never close.

lexxyfour got 20.3 each from Kenneth Walker and Ja’Marr Chase, plus 18.8 from Kyren Williams—and still lost by almost 24. Brian Thomas (1.3), Drake Maye (5.8) and Mark Andrews (3.9) turned three stars into an 0–3 record.

“Three players over 18. Three losses. Great system.”Imagined postgame quote · lexxyfour
